objective: maximise mean spell_f1_mean over the degraded runs (tuning matches x seeds [0, 1, 2]), harness.run -> pm.evaluate
tie_rule: among combos within 0.002 of the best mean spell_f1_mean, the one closest to the a priori values (sum over keys of |grid index - a priori grid index|), then the first in grid order
source: Bassek, Rein, Weber et al., Sci Data 12, 195 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y, CC BY 4.0
